_doc: Blog EN · Bar Checklists Kit Pro (bar/SPEC D1, 18-oct-2026). El id es el del CATÁLOGO (products-catalog.ts),
que con urlByLang.en pinta la landing EN /en/digital-products/bar-checklist-templates y $19.
Posts: los tres del blog EN que más hablan de bar (Bartender Consultant, márgenes y beverage cost, Sommelier).
Víctimas = SLUGS EN de la landing, por relevancia y por reparto (son los más repetidos del corpus EN): HACCP en el
del bartender (se queda el Food Cost Kit por el pour cost) y el Restaurant Financial Plan Kit en los otros dos.
Nunca el Restaurant Checklists Kit Pro, hermano de línea y venta cruzada del dashboard.

prompt-library-bartender-consulting.parrafo: Recipes and costing only pay off when the bar runs the same way every shift. The {ENLACE} writes that routine down: bar opening and closing, the cocktail, draft beer and wine stations, daily duties for the head bartender, bartender and barback, and a weekly inventory by category, ready to print and initial.

bar-profit-margins-beverage-costing.parrafo: Pour cost slips when nobody counts. The {ENLACE} adds the routine behind the numbers: a weekly inventory of spirits, beer, wine and mixers, a monthly pour cost and waste review on the bar manager's checklist, and a cash drawer count with the over/short against the POS Z report.

prompt-library-sommelier-consulting.parrafo: Wine by the glass loses money one open bottle at a time. The {ENLACE} includes a wine station checklist (whites and rosés at 46–50 °F, no open bottle older than 3 days, the by-the-glass board kept current) and a cellar check, alongside the bar's opening, closing and inventory routines.
